evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches contrib/guix/ manifests and CI requirements to update Guix reproducible build pinning.
rationale: Fixes native Guix build failures on riscv64-linux hosts caused by unsupported packages and test suite failures. As noted in issue #36232, Guix failed on RISC-V systems with 'package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux'; while worthwhile for architecture support, native RISC-V Guix building is a niche platform.
